scope: Unchanged reviewed GNU Tar Autotest selections, including every archive format registered by each selected original. Native atlocal is copied unchanged; atconfig build paths point into private fixtures. AUTOTEST_PATH selects a wrapper preserving argv[0]=tar and instruments every Tar invocation with child tracing. Permission selections run as uid/gid 65534 with no supplementary groups using byte-verified private executable copies. Test helpers are native dependencies, not ports.
